title: Pietro at the British Chess Championship! :)
originalTitle: Pietro at the British Chess Championship! :)
transcript: I played chess at the British Chess Championship alongside grandmasters and champions, but not only them. There were hundreds of amateur players of every skill level. So many that the tables with the chessboards seemed to never end. This is not the entire table, by the way. And I even got to see Bodhana Sivanandan, an 11-year-old [music] prodigy, comment her win against a grandmaster. I had so much fun at the event, [music] and I even managed to get my first ever trophy from a competition, and I can't wait to see who is going to win the main event.
